completion:
Perform a visual inspection.
3. Use non-destructive testing.
4. Take high-resolution photographs and videos.
5. Record the location and nature of each defect.
6. Measure the dimensions and severity.
7. Categorize defects based on type and potential impact.
8. Reference the relevant bridge design specifications.
9. Document any environmental factors contributing to the defects.
10. Include recommendations for repair or further investigation.
11. Compile a comprehensive report.
